scope: Implement all five previously missing function fact categories; never narrow the final language support boundary.
decisions: Path-qualified plain function names remain absolute; unqualified names take their parsed namespace. Native aliases compose alias.name.
The inferred marker uses one CSharp compile-time policy constant and generated SLG getter; source flags distinguish no-input versus typed-input inferred signatures.

Legacy generic facts keep the first primary-parameter trait bound and last associated equality, resolved by the same namespace/import/type spelling logic; other parameter constraints do not overwrite those primary legacy slots.

Impl identity is trait.owner.member or owner.member, with builtin/array owner identities qualified by the declaring namespace. Self input/return metadata use the actual owner type, and associated maps sort ordinal UTF16.
Native status/out wraps the declared success type as Result<success, Int32>, retaining the actual parsed function name after visibility/status modifiers.
Type-token formatting is shared by ordinary TypeAnnotation nodes and parsed impl owner headers; no synthetic AST or cloned source package.
preparationCorrection: Allocate bound/associated output fields only after the equal-type result succeeds, keeping outer ownership consistent at the Result join. Previous failed record63 retained.
